title: ר' מניומי בר חלקיה בזמן רב

paragraphs: R. Minyomi bar Ḥilkiyah, in Rav's time. I did not find that he lived in Rav's time (see above, Ḥilkiyah, father of R. Minyamin). Rav Ḥilkiyah bar Tovya and Rav Huna bar Ḥiyya sat, Gittin 57a. R. Maḥseya bar Idi said: R. Yoḥanan said, Yoma 3b; at 2a it is a scribal error. R. Ḥama bar Gurya said, Menaḥot 32b. It is known that R. Ḥama bar Gurya was Rav's student; Rav Minyomi bar Ḥilkiyah spoke in his name. How then could R. Minyomi live in Rav's time?
